quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What is the purpose of rumble strips?

options.text: They alert drivers to tire problems.
They test a vehicle's shock absorbers.
They use vibration and sound to warn drivers that their vehicle is leaving the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They use vibration and sound to warn drivers that their vehicle is leaving the road.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips make noise and vibration to warn drowsy or distracted drivers that they are leaving the road or approaching a stop sign or signal.

questions.question: If you park your vehicle in an unusual location:

options.text: Make sure other drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
Park five feet from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure other drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
questions.explanation: Drivers must ensure their parked vehicles are not hazards. Always park where drivers approaching from any direction can see your car.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers to be careful in wet conditions because the road surface becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: Orange background signs are:
questions.explanation: Orange is used only for construction and maintenance warning signs.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: All wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns that wet pavement can cause you to lose control. Slow down because wet roads increase your stopping distance.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, give the right-of-way to any driver:
questions.explanation: After stopping, vehicles proceed in the order they arrived at the intersection. If multiple vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left yields to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: When parallel parking downhill:

options.text: Turn your wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your wheels away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels sharply toward the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the curb. When parking uphill without a curb, turn wheels toward the road edge. When parking uphill with a curb, turn wheels away from the curb.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: When driving behind a large truck on the freeway:

options.text: Stay close in bad weather so the driver can see farther for you.
Keep more distance than you would behind a regular car.
Stay one car length behind so the driver can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep more distance than you would behind a regular car.
questions.explanation: If you drive too close behind a truck, the driver cannot see you in the side mirrors and does not know you are there. Tailgating any vehicle is dangerous because you lose your safety cushion if the vehicle suddenly stops.

questions.question: On a multilane road, a dashed yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: Only drivers on the dashed line side can pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only drivers on the dashed line side can pass.
questions.explanation: When there is a dashed line and a solid line, only drivers next to the dashed line can cross to pass. Drivers next to the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line means the action is prohibited. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Road construction or maintenance area ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road construction or maintenance area ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards. Orange color means construction or maintenance work is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge onto the road from the right.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: A series of curves are ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A series of curves are ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you about a winding road with curves coming up.

questions.question: When changing lanes:

options.text: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Only use the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Check multiple times and watch traffic both ahead and to the side.

questions.question: A double solid yellow line down the center of the road means passing is:
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is forbidden in both directions.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing without a signal. You should:

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At this type of crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be prepared to stop. Never try to race past an oncoming train.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge to another lane.

questions.question: If you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or carrying a white cane:

options.text: The pedestrian must yield the right-of-way.
Honk your horn to alert them.

questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the person is blind or partially blind. You must yield the right-of-way to them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers that bicycles may cross the road at this location.

questions.question: When are streets and highways most slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.

questions.explanation: Roads are slipperiest when rain first starts. The water mixes with oil and chemicals on the road that have not been washed away yet. Drive slowly and carefully when it first starts to rain.

questions.question: When parked uphill on a street with a curb, set the brake and turn the front wheels:
questions.explanation: When parked uphill with a curb, turn wheels away from the curb. When parked uphill without a curb or parked downhill, turn wheels toward the curb or road edge.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
Look over your shoulder to check blind spots.
Check for other cars moving into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder. Also check for other cars entering your lane. Never change lanes or pass in an intersection.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. You may need to change direction, slow down for a steep drop, or watch for other hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that pedestrians cross at this location.

questions.question: This warning sign tells you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: To turn quickly, where should your hands be on the steering wheel?

options.text: On opposite sides of the wheel.
Next to each other at the top.

questions.correctAnswerText: On opposite sides of the wheel.
questions.explanation: Keep both hands on opposite sides of the steering wheel. This position is comfortable and helps you turn safely at higher speeds.

questions.question: What speed should you always drive?

options.text: The same speed as the cars around you.
A speed that is safe for current road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: A speed that is safe for current road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Your driving speed depends on road conditions, weather, and the speed limit. Never drive faster than the speed limit. Slow down when conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A left arm held straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from either direction.

questions.explanation: Be very careful at all railroad crossings. Only cross when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Also watch for vehicles that must stop at all railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks with hazardous materials.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: When should you increase the distance between your vehicle and the car ahead?

options.text: When you are following a small car.
When another driver is tailgating you.
When you are driving slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: When another driver is tailgating you.
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, create more space in front of your vehicle. Slow down gradually or change lanes. Do not brake suddenly, as this could cause a crash.

questions.question: If you cannot see clearly into an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down and look both ways.
Keep your speed and look both ways.
Stop, then move forward slowly until you can see clearly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then move forward slowly until you can see clearly.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you approach an intersection. If you cannot see cross traffic clearly, stop completely. Then move forward slowly until you can see in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they have completely crossed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disabled license plates, Disabled Veteran license plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: When can you legally block an intersection?

options.text: When you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, you cannot enter an intersection unless you can drive completely across before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection is illegal and you can be cited.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from the lane next to the solid yellow line.
No one can pass in either direction.
You can pass from the lane next to the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane next to the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, drivers in the lane next to the broken line can cross it to pass. Drivers in the lane next to the solid line cannot pass.
